name: FV_SAM_TRADING_PARTNER
description: This table stores information about SAM Trading Partners.

columns.name: SAM_TRADING_PARTNER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for SAM Trading Partner.

columns.name: UNIQUE_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER_SAM
columns.description: The Unique Entity Identifier (SAM) for the entity.

columns.name: UNIQUE_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER_DUNS
columns.description: The Dun and Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number for the entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_EFT_INDICATOR
columns.description: This field is used to make EFT payments at multiple remittance locations for the entity.

columns.name: CAGE_CODE
columns.description: Commercial and government entity (CAGE) code is a unique identifier assigned to an entity which provides a standardized method of identifying a given facility at a specific location. All US entities must meet a CAGE code validation process, or will be assigned one by the defense logistics information service (DLIS).

columns.name: DODAAC_CODE
columns.description: The department of defense activity address code (DODAAC) for non-civilian government agencies (DoD).  This is filled with the letters "DOD" followed by the agency's 6 digit DoDAAC number.

columns.name: SAM_EXTRACT_CODE
columns.description: Single character code that defines the status of the record being sent in the extract. The monthly file contains the complete record whether active or expired. For the daily files, the SAM extract code further specifies which data elements are sent for the record.

columns.name: PURPOSE_OF_REGISTRATION_CODE
columns.description: The purpose of an entity’s registration in entity management.

columns.name: INITIAL_REGISTRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date the initial entity registration was submitted.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date this current registration will expire or has already expired. This date is 365 days after the user submitted the registration.

columns.name: SAM_TRD_PARTNER_UPDATED_DATE
columns.description: The date this registration was last updated.  This can change while the activation date remains the same for many reasons, such as POC changes, reference data changes, or SAM Technical Team database changes.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_DATE
columns.description: The date this registration record was made active.  This can differ from the date that the registration was submitted due to the time it takes for TIN Validation and CAGE code assignment/validation.

columns.name: LEGAL_BUSINESS_NAME
columns.description: The legal business name of the entity.

columns.name: DBA_NAME
columns.description: The 'doing business as' name of the entity.  This name must be different from the legal business name.

columns.name: ENTITY_DIVISION_NAME
columns.description: This field is the division name provided by the entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_DIVISION_NUMBER
columns.description: This field is the division number provided by the entity.

columns.name: AGENCY_BUSINESS_PURPOSE_CODE

columns.name: NO_PUBLIC_DISPLAY_CODE
columns.description: The field indicates whether an entity has chosen to opt-out of being displayed in public search results. You can chose to opt-out of being displayed in public search results via the website.  Opting out may result in a reduction in federal government business opportunities, and subcontractors choosing this option will not be visible to prime contractors.
